title: Colely Negroni
ldInstructionsRaw: Stir ingredients together with ice to dilute and chill. Strain into a coupe. Twist an orange peel over the top of the drink and discard.
Coffee-infused Campari: Add 1 Tbsp. of whole coffee beans to 250 ml. Campari in a jar. Steep for 3 hours, shaking occasionally. Strain through a coffee filter.
